subject: The parts of the gun-bot family docs/GUN_BOT_TICKS.md left partial: the torpedo intercept solver 008FBB00/008FB8D0, the entity lead-point predictor behind vtable slot 100h, DepthChargeBot's tick 008FC080, AAGunnerBot's fire byte, the 008FFF20 callees and 00959C20's solution builders. Ghidra was read-only for this packet.
reuses: include/bsp/gun_bot_ticks.hpp for GunBotTargetValidity, gun_bot_target_still_valid_008ffa20 and kAAGunnerBotRangeFraction
docs/ROBOT_CONFIG.md for the descriptor header and the per-level strides; the Lua key names come from the readers it tabulates

functions.name: BSP_Math_SolveInterceptTime
functions.abi: __fastcall(ECX const float3* shooter, EDX const float3* target, float speed, const float3* target_velocity, float* t1, float* t2) -> int, RET 10h, body 008fb8d0-008fbafb
functions.note: a = |v|^2 - speed^2, b = dot(shooter - target, v), c = |shooter - target|^2. The quadratic arm needs |a| outside 1e-4, uses disc = b*b - 4*a*c and roots (b +/- sqrt(disc)) / (2a). The exact intercept needs a linear coefficient of 2*dot(d, v), so every non-abeam solution under-leads.

calls.role: the CRT square root of the discriminant

functions.name: BSP_Math_SolveInterceptPoint
functions.abi: __fastcall(ECX const float3* shooter, EDX const float3* target, float speed, const float3* target_velocity, float3* out) -> bool, RET 0Ch, body 008fbb00-008fbc08
functions.note: one root uses t1 at 008fbb9e, two roots use t2 at 008fbb3c; out = target + t * target_velocity and EAX is the boolean, not the pointer

calls.role: the root solve; the two out pointers alias the routine's own speed and velocity argument slots

corrections.was: the lead-point predictor is called at 008FFBC6
corrections.is: 008FFBC6 is CALL EAX with EAX = bot->vtable[44h], the call that fetches the fire target; the slot 100h call is the CALL EDX at 008FFC03 on that target
corrections.evidence: 008ffbad loads [EDX+44h] into EAX, 008ffbc6 calls it, 008ffbcc-008ffbce load [EAX] then [+100h] from the RETURNED object's vtable, and 008ffc01 moves that object into ECX before the CALL EDX at 008ffc03

corrections.was: 00902C86, 00902CAC, 00902CC7 and 00902CD0 are a second vtable[100h] sample
corrections.is: those four sites are 008FDAF0, 00438B10, 00438B10 and 00438AA0; the only vtable[100h] call in 00902920 is at 00902BFD
corrections.evidence: the Ghidra listing of 00902920 contains exactly one [EDX+0x100] load, at 00902bf0, and its CALL EDX is at 00902bfd

corrections.was: the four lead scalars vtable[100h] takes and the (0.6, 0.6, 0.6) direction every caller passes are open questions
corrections.is: they are SectionTargetChance, EngineRoomWeight, MagazineWeight and FueltankWeight, and the third argument is a fraction of the hull half-extents rather than a direction
corrections.evidence: 008FCA10 stores those four Lua keys at TailGunnerBot descriptor +20h, +24h, +28h and +2Ch, which are the four floats 008ffb8c-008ffbaa push; 00816820-008168d5 draws the box against [ship+538h]+0A0h/+0A4h/+0A8h

corrections.was: 008FBB00(runSpeed, targetVelocity, out) solves the torpedo intercept
corrections.is: it also takes the shooter and target points in ECX and EDX, and what it solves is an intercept whose linear coefficient is half the exact one, so it under-leads every target that is not stationary and not exactly abeam
corrections.evidence: 008fbb00's RET 0Ch leaves two register arguments; 008fb8d0 builds b = dot(d, v) at 008fb949-008fb96b, disc = b*b - 4*a*c at 008fba02 and divides by a + a at 008fba40, where the exact form needs 2*dot(d, v)

corrections.was: the friendly entity is projected forward by 1000 seconds of its own velocity and 004F3730 tests it against the torpedo run
corrections.is: the projection scales the entity's +94h/+9Ch forward vector, and 004F3730 is a two-dimensional segment crossing that reads only the x and z components
corrections.evidence: 00900630 and 00900647 read [EDI+0x94] and [EDI+0x9c]; 004f3730 and 004f3630 index only [0] and [1] of all their float arguments

corrections.is: 00902920 is AAGunnerBot and 009030C0 is AAFlakBot; docs/GUN_BOT_TICKS.md section 2 already recorded this
corrections.evidence: 00902b6e loads [00E19998] and 00902b68 indexes it with skill * 10h, which docs/ROBOT_CONFIG.md gives as the AAGunnerBot descriptor and its 10h six-level stride; AAFlakBot's stride is 20h

open_questions: The sign of ContinuousFireTime in the shipped DepthChargeBot Lua. The static rule at 008fc3c7 ends the burst when bot+60h < ContinuousFireTime, and bot+60h is already at or below zero on every firing frame, so a positive value ends the burst on its first frame.
What ship+0A20h holds. 0093A570 scans 10h-byte records keyed by an int and the three section ids are 5, 6 and 8; the producer was not found.
Why 00902920 calls target->vtable[5Ch](2) at 0090308c and discards the answer.
004F3560's tolerance rule and 00951FC0's limit test at the tail.
00957BD0, the kind-1/2 arm's solution builder, and 00957740's 00957850-00957bcc tail.
008FF040 and 008FF310: Ghidra still has no function at either address, so this packet did not read them.
